content:
Seeed Studio has launched two Nordic nRF52840-based Bluetooth LE e-paper kits preloaded with the OpenDisplay open-source firmware for e-paper displays and supporting Home Assistant integration. The OpenDisplay 4.26″ Mono features a 4.26-inch monochrome/grayscale display with 800×480 resolution and partial refresh support, while the OpenDisplay 7.3″ Color Kit is equipped with a 7.3-inch Spectra 6 color e-paper with the same resolution. Both are powered by a 2,000 mAh battery and feature a few buttons for control and reset. Seeed Studio OpenDisplay kits specifications: MCU – Nordic Semi nRF52840 CPU – Arm Cortex-M4F microcontroller @ up to 64 MHz Memory – 256 KB SRAM Storage – 1 MB flash Wireless – Bluetooth LE 5.0, NFC, 802.15.4 connectivity Display OpenDisplay 4.26″ Mono Kit 4.26-inch monochrome ePaper Black and white (default); optional 4-gray mode Partial Refresh – Supported in black-and-white mode only Resolution – 800 × 480 Controller – Seeed XIAO EN05 driver board [...]
